models.notes: fact-check (2026-10-18): the earlier note labelled the indoor sound as 'SLo-Lo-Mid-Hi-SHi 21-30-37-43', which is five step names for four values, so the mapping was wrong. Corrected: the source (Cooling Company) gives four values, lowest to highest; the fan-step names are not confirmed. The dB figures are unchanged and were not re-verified (no web access this pass). Capacities/efficiency are for the single-split pair. Sound = indoor cooling 21-30-37-43 dB(A), four steps lowest to highest (heating identical); indoor sound power 57 dB(A). Mitsubishi France FTI gives heating 3.2 kW (0.5-3.5) and SCOP 4.2 - UK listings and EPREL give 3.15 kW / SCOP 4.3. Operating range from the OBH823 service manual (VF models; heating limit -10 C). MULTI: HR multi indoor units are for the budget MXZ-HA outdoor family (e.g. MXZ-2HA40VF2) per Logicool and the 2024 Mitsubishi multisplit catalogue; a UK combination-chart snippet showed no MXZ-3F54VF4 marks for MSZ-HR25VF. An older Orion listing bundles MXZ-2F42VF + 2x MSZ-HR25VF, so treat MXZ-F compatibility as NOT confirmed. Model suffix: UK library also lists MSZ-HR25VFK (Wi-Fi variant); EU sells VF2/VFK2 - confirm the UK 2026 suffix with distributor.

Models listed are from UK bundles only (Cooling Company 4x AP25VGK; Orion 2x AP50VGK). AY and LN wall units are expected to be connectable as for 2F42/3F54 but per-model rules for 4F72 not seen. Official connectable capacity range not found; 5.0 kW indoor units may need port adaptors.

openQuestions: ACCESS: WebFetch/curl could not reach any Mitsubishi domain (library.mitsubishielectric.co.uk, les.mitsubishielectric.co.uk, confort.mitsubishielectric.fr) nor EPREL/Eurovent (DNS failure / proxy 403). Every value here comes from search-engine snippets of those documents plus UK/EU distributor pages, so ALL records are 'provisional'. Download and check the UK PI sheets: MSZ-HR (library download_full/4097), MSZ-AY/AP (4788), MSZ-AP 2019 (3699), MXZ-F range (4206) and the UK multi-split combination chart, then upgrade confidence.
Web search budget for this run was exhausted before every gap could be chased; remaining nulls need a follow-up pass.

Current UK model suffixes for 2026: MSZ-HR..VF vs ..VFK / ..VFK2 (Wi-Fi) ; MXZ-..VF3 vs ..VF4 vs ..VF5 ; MSZ-LN colour suffixes (W/V/R/B). Confirm against the 2025/2026 Mitsubishi LES UK price list (a 2025 LES price list PDF exists on fsw.uk.com) or distributor stock codes.
MSZ-AP25/35/50VGK appear superseded in the UK by MSZ-AY25/35/50VGK (2023, secondary sources). Confirm AP availability before quoting; AY should be the default 'standard' Mitsubishi option.

Multi-split official rules not found: min/max total connected indoor capacity per MXZ-F outdoor, per-port maximum indoor size, which ports are 9.52 vs 12.7 gas, adaptor (different-diameter joint) part numbers for 5.0 kW indoors, and whether the 3F/4F need extra charge when 3-4 indoors are connected.

MSZ-HR multi compatibility: Logicool and the 2024 Mitsubishi multisplit catalogue tie HR multi units to MXZ-HA outdoors (e.g. MXZ-2HA40VF2), but an older Orion UK listing sells MXZ-2F42VF + 2x MSZ-HR25VF. MXZ-HA outdoors were not catalogued.

Conflicts to resolve from official data: MSZ-AP50VGK/MUZ-AP50VG gas pipe 9.52 vs 12.7 mm and outdoor sound power (56/64/69 dB); MUZ-AY25VG weight (26.5-31 kg); MUZ-LN25VG2 weight (33/35 kg); MUZ-LN50VG2 max height 12 vs 15 m; MXZ-3F54 total pipe 50 vs 60 m; MXZ-4F72 SEER/SCOP 8.13/4.07 vs 8.53/4.12; MUZ-HR25VF max height 12 vs 10 m.

Missing outdoor sound power (needed for noise / planning assessment): MUZ-AP50VG, MUZ-AY35VG, MUZ-AY50VG. Missing breaker ratings: MUZ-HR50VF, MUZ-LN35VG2, MUZ-LN50VG2, MXZ-4F72VF4. Mitsubishi UK states fuse ratings are guidance only - electrician must size cable and protection.

Missing pre-charge / additional-charge data for MUZ-AY..VG and MUZ-HR50VF, and pipe limits for MUZ-AY35VG / MUZ-AY50VG / MUZ-LN35VG2. Missing operating ranges for AY and LN35/LN50 (LN25 FR sheet: -10..+46 cooling, -15..+24 heating). AP range is single-source.

Warranty: official Mitsubishi Electric UK air-to-air warranty T&Cs not retrieved. Secondary sources: 3 years standard, up to 5 years via Accredited Installer / Partner Programme; one installer claims 7 years parts. Need: accreditation requirements for 'Dang, It's Hot', registration deadline (3 months is stated for Lossnay), servicing conditions.
7.1 kW not catalogued: MSZ-AP71VGK/MUZ-AP71VG and MSZ-HR71VF exist (Logicool, Spanish HR datasheet); LN tops out at LN60 (6.0 kW). Add if a pilot property needs >5 kW.
UK-rated vs nominal capacities: several UK retailers quote 'UK rated' cooling (e.g. AP35 3.26 or 3.47 kW) that differs from EN14511 nominal values used here - decide which basis the sizing tool uses.

FACT-CHECK PASS (2026-10-18, adversarial): this pass had NO web access. The shared WebSearch budget for the run was already used up, and WebFetch failed with a DNS error on every domain tried (orionairsales.co.uk, logicool-ac.com, coolingcompany.co.uk, prosatech.de, eurovent-certification.com, manualslib.com, topten.eu, mitsubishi-electric.co.nz and en.wikipedia.org). No claim could be checked against an independent outside source. Checks were limited to internal arithmetic, consistency across records, and cross-checks with other repo research files. Every claim listed below as unverifiable still needs an outside check.

Fact-check CONFIRMED (internal arithmetic only): the MUZ-HR25VF charge chain holds together. Factory charge ~0.40 kg + (20 m max - 7 m pre-charged) x 20 g/m = 660 g, which equals the installation-manual maximum charge quoted in the record notes. Three figures from three different documents agree.
Fact-check CONFIRMED (internal arithmetic only): R32 GWP 675. The Orion MSZ-AP50VGK listing gives 1.00 kg = 0.68 tCO2e, and 1.00 x 0.675 = 0.675, which rounds to 0.68.

Fact-check CONFIRMED against recalled thresholds (EU Delegated Regulation 626/2011 Annex II as retained in GB, https://eur-lex.europa.eu/eli/reg_del/2011/626/oj, NOT fetched): every energyClassCooling and energyClassHeating value in this file matches its SEER/SCOP. The recalled thresholds are SEER A+++ >= 8.50, A++ 6.10-8.50; SCOP A+++ >= 5.10, A++ 4.60-5.10, A+ 4.00-4.60. The same thresholds would give the null classes as: MSZ/MUZ-AY25 heating A++; MSZ/MUZ-LN35VG2 heating A+++ (SCOP 5.10 is exactly on the boundary); MXZ-3F54VF4 A+++ cooling / A++ heating; MXZ-4F72VF4 A++ cooling / A+ heating. These are DERIVED, not sourced, so they are left null. Confirm them from the EPREL label.

Fact-check CONFIRMED (cross-file): MSZ-AP35VGK is superseded by MSZ-AY35VGK. docs/research/data/equipment-prices.json records, from a separate search extract, that the Orion page says MSZ-AP35VGK has been replaced by MSZ-AY35VGK. The '2023' date and the AP25/AP50 supersession were not independently checked.

Fact-check UNVERIFIABLE (no web): Mitsubishi UK warranty (3 years standard; up to 5 years parts with an Accredited Installer). No independent source could be reached, so check the official T&Cs before quoting to customers.

Fact-check UNVERIFIABLE, internal tension: the 5.0 kW gas pipe size. MSZ-HR50VF and MSZ/MUZ-LN50VG2 are recorded as 9.52 mm gas. However, the MSZ-AP50VGK record has a 12.7 mm conflict (Mitsubishi NZ and a UK retailer), the LN50 notes mention a service-manual extract showing 12.7 mm, and the MXZ notes say 5.0 kW indoor units may need port adaptors (which implies 12.7 mm). Treat the 9.52 mm values for HR50 and LN50 as unconfirmed until the installation manual is checked, before pipe is ordered.

Fact-check UNVERIFIABLE, internal tension: MSZ-AP25VGK. The notes quote a '6 A BS88 HRC fuse on indoor feed' (Orion), but every indoor record's powerSupply says the indoor unit is fed through the outdoor-unit interconnect. Both cannot apply to a single supply arrangement. Ask the electrician to confirm from the installation manual whether the indoor unit has a separate fused supply.

Fact-check UNVERIFIABLE: MUZ-AY35VG weight of 27 kg (Climacom, single source). For the sibling MUZ-AY25VG in the same 800x550x285 casing, Orion (31 kg) and Climacom (26.5 kg) conflict, and MUZ-AP25/35VG in the same casing are 31 kg (Orion). Climacom may run about 4-5 kg below Orion, so treat 27 kg as unconfirmed for lifting and bracket planning.

Fact-check UNVERIFIABLE (no web): MXZ-3F54VF4 total pipe 50 m (vs a 60 m snippet) and 25 A breaker; MXZ-4F72VF4 SEER/SCOP 8.13/4.07 (vs 8.53/4.12); MSZ-LN35VG2 SEER 9.5 (Eurovent snippet); MUZ-LN50VG2 maximum height 12 m vs 15 m; MXZ-2F42VF4 30 m pre-charge. These figures are unchanged. Re-check them against the Mitsubishi UK PI sheets or the Eurovent/EPREL pages when web access is available.
